title: introduce capabilities_query endpoint + structured-output and function-call profiles in model catalog
author: Jordan Lee
description:
Motivation: Product teams need a single, efficient query surface to discover model capabilities and runtime hints that drive API behavior (streaming vs non-streaming, structured-output templates, function-calling profiles and per-model pricing/limits). This PR adds a new endpoint /v1/model_catalog/capabilities_query that returns a normalized capability document for each model and expands the model index with structured-output and function_calling profiles plus optional per-route pricing hints. The change is designed to be backward-compatible with the existing /v1/models listing and the OpenAI compatibility shim.

What this PR does: Adds a query-focused catalog endpoint that accepts flexible filters (capability flags, max_sequence, supports_streaming, openai_compat_level) and returns a compact capability payload. Introduces two first-class capability families: structured_output_profiles (named templates + JSONSchema hints + stability score) and function_calling_profiles (preferred calling semantics, argument mapping, and failure_fallback policies). Adds a pricing_limits field (per-1000-token cost_hint and soft_rate_limit) to model entries to aid routing/costing decisions at the gateway. Updates the OpenAI shim to map compatibility_level -> openai_deprecation_hints so older clients get migration guidance. Includes tests, docs, and console list adjustments to surface the new query filters.

Compatibility and migration: Existing consumers of /v1/models are unaffected. The new endpoint is additive. The OpenAI shim will continue to expose the current compatibility flags but now emits an additional deprecation hint if a model's openai_compat_level is below the requested threshold. Operators should review release notes for telemetry changes: new metrics were added (catalog.query.latency, catalog.query.result_size, catalog.query.filtered_count).

Checklist:
- [x] API endpoint implementation server-side (HTTP + SDK bindings)
- [x] OpenAPI/SDK docs updated
- [x] Unit and integration tests for filtering and profile shapes
- [x] Console UI: add capability filter and pricing column
- [x] Migration notes and telemetry added

Rollout plan: Feature-gated via feature_flag:capabilities_query. Default off for Dedicated customers in the initial rollout window; enabled in hosted after 72-hour dark-traffic validation.

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps profile schemas minimal (string identifiers + lightweight JSONSchema references) to avoid inflating catalog payloads; future work (ENG-2089) will add a cached profile store for richer profiles.
